HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   B. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)

   B. Replace the compass rose

13. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)

   D. Hide all money underground
